ignore_versions.title: ignore_versions[]
ignore_versions.description: Release tag names (or picomatch glob patterns) to skip when resolving the latest version.

examples.name: CleanRip
examples.author: emu_kidid
examples.description_short: Disc Backup Tool for GC/Wii Discs
examples.description_long: A tool to backup your GameCube/Wii discs via IOS58. Creates 1:1 backups for archival purposes without any requirements for custom IOS (cIOS). Supports USB 2.0, NTFS, exFAT and Front SD.

name.description: Display name of the homebrew application as shown in the catalog.

author.description: Name of the application author or primary maintainer.

description_short.description: Brief one-line summary of the application, up to 160 characters. Displayed in catalog listings.
examples: The swiss army knife of GameCube homebrew
Disc Backup Tool for GC/Wii Discs

description_long.description: Extended description of the application, up to 500 characters. Displayed on the application detail page.
examples: Swiss is an all-in-one homebrew utility for the Nintendo GameCube. It allows browsing and loading DOL executables and GCM disc images from various storage devices.

category.description: Category the application belongs to. Must be one of: games, emulators, utilities, demos, media.

platforms.description: List of compatible hardware platforms. If omitted, no platform compatibility is specified.

peripherals.description: List of supported or required peripherals and accessories.

source.description: Defines where to download the application binary. Exactly one variant must be configured, identified by the `type` discriminator.

oneOf.title: GitHub release
oneOf.description: Download an asset from a GitHub release.

type.description: Discriminator identifying this source as a GitHub release.

repository.description: GitHub repository in `owner/repo` format. Nested groups are not supported.

asset_pattern.description: Picomatch glob pattern matched against release asset filenames. Selects the asset to download.

oneOf.title: GitLab release
oneOf.description: Download an asset from a GitLab release.

type.description: Discriminator identifying this source as a GitLab release.

repository.description: GitLab project path in `owner/repo` format. Subgroups are not supported.

asset_pattern.description: Picomatch glob pattern matched against release asset filenames.

oneOf.title: itch.io
oneOf.description: Download an upload from an itch.io game page.

type.description: Discriminator identifying this source as an itch.io upload.

creator.description: itch.io username of the creator. Forms part of the URL: `https://[creator].itch.io/[game]`.

game.description: itch.io game/project slug. Forms part of the URL: `https://[creator].itch.io/[game]`.

upload.description: Picomatch glob pattern matched against an upload's display name or filename on the itch.io download page. The first matching upload is selected.

format.description: Expected file extension of the downloaded asset. Used to assemble the local filename `{game}.{format}`.

oneOf.title: Direct URL
oneOf.description: Download from a direct URL. Used when the application is not hosted on a Git forge or itch.io.

type.description: Discriminator identifying this source as a direct URL download.

url.description: Direct download URL of the application binary or archive.

file_name.description: Override the filename derived from the URL. Useful when the URL does not contain a meaningful filename.

treatments.description: Ordered list of post-download processing steps applied to the downloaded asset. Treatments are executed sequentially. Each entry is identified by its `treatment` discriminator, which determines the operation and the shape of `arguments`.

oneOf.title: Extract Archive
oneOf.description: Extracts a downloaded archive (ZIP, 7z, TAR, etc.) into the working directory. Uses 7-Zip under the hood.

treatment.description: Discriminator identifying this step as an archive extraction.

prefixItems.title: Archive pattern
prefixItems.description: Glob pattern matching the archive file(s) to extract.

prefixItems.title: Destination
prefixItems.description: Directory to extract into, relative to the working directory. Defaults to the working directory itself.

oneOf.title: Move Contents
oneOf.description: Moves files from the working directory to the output directory. Use this to select which files end up in the final package and where.

treatment.description: Discriminator identifying this step as a contents move.

prefixItems.title: Source pattern
prefixItems.description: Glob pattern matching files in the working directory to move. If the pattern ends with `/`, all contents of that directory are moved.

prefixItems.title: Destination
prefixItems.description: Target path in the output directory. End with `/` to treat as a directory. Parent directories are created automatically.

oneOf.title: Delete Contents
oneOf.description: Deletes files matching a pattern from the working directory. Useful for cleaning up unwanted files before further processing.

treatment.description: Discriminator identifying this step as a contents delete.

prefixItems.title: Pattern
prefixItems.description: Glob pattern matching files to delete. Deletes recursively.

oneOf.title: Copy from Registry
oneOf.description: Copies files from the app's registry entry directory into the output. Use this to include static assets like icons or banners that are stored in the registry.

treatment.description: Discriminator identifying this step as a registry copy.

prefixItems.title: Source pattern
prefixItems.description: Glob pattern matching files in the registry entry directory.

prefixItems.title: Destination
prefixItems.description: Target path in the output directory. End with `/` to treat as a directory.

oneOf.title: Download from URL
oneOf.description: Downloads a file from a URL into the working directory. Use this to fetch additional assets not included in the main source download.

treatment.description: Discriminator identifying this step as a URL download.

prefixItems.title: URL
prefixItems.description: Direct download URL of the file.

prefixItems.title: Destination
prefixItems.description: File path in the working directory to save the download to.
